id: 27_Safety Quiz Safety Quiz Competition Work At Height Fire Crane Excavation Confine
title: 安全竞赛：高处作业、消防、起重、开挖与受限空间
source_doc: course/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/27_Safety Quiz Safety Quiz Competition Work At Height Fire Crane Excavation Confine.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/27_Safety Quiz Safety Quiz Competition Work At Height Fire Crane Excavation Confine/src.py

points.K1: 竞赛形式：五个主题一百题
points.K6: 起重机能吊的风速看机型

shots.scene: 欣欣站在五个主题卡片前，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of five topic cards and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 五大主题安全竞赛，开始！

shots.scene: 五个图标：梯子、火焰、起重机、井口、挖掘机
shots.prompt_en: Five icons: a ladder, a flame, a crane, a manhole and an excavator. No people.
shots.narration: 高处、消防、起重、有限空间、开挖。

shots.scene: 阿杰对着一叠空白题册发愁
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks worried at a stack of blank quiz booklets.
shots.narration: 阿杰想系统地测一测安全知识。

shots.scene: 小研把五本空白题册摆成一排
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lines up five blank quiz booklets.
shots.narration: 小研说：五个主题，一套题都带答案。

shots.section_title: 竞赛形式：五个主题一百题
shots.scene: 五本题册，每本二十格
shots.prompt_en: Five booklets, each with twenty blank boxes. No people.
shots.narration: 每个主题二十道选择题，带答案。
overlay: 竞赛形式：五个主题一百题

shots.section_title: 竞赛形式：五个主题一百题
shots.scene: 阿杰翻开题册，头上问号消失
shots.prompt_en: The young male student opens a booklet and the question mark above his head disappears.
shots.narration: 做完一百题，检验知识、解开疑问。

shots.section_title: 竞赛形式：五个主题一百题
shots.scene: 每本题册开头的目录页
shots.prompt_en: A blank table of contents page at the front of a booklet. No people.
shots.narration: 每个主题先有简介，再是题目。

shots.scene: 梯子和平台图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a ladder and a raised platform. No people.
shots.narration: 高处作业第一题：什么算高处作业？

shots.scene: 四张选项卡片
shots.prompt_en: Four option cards with icons: a 6 ft mark, a ladder, a person near an edge and a 10 ft mark. No people.
shots.narration: 6英尺以上？只用梯子？10英尺以上？

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案c，人可能坠落受伤的地方作业。

shots.scene: 坠落、不合适设备、无护栏临边、风雨图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a falling person, an unsuitable tool, an unprotected edge and wind and rain. No people.
shots.narration: 简介里列了高处作业的常见危害：

shots.scene: 四个图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The four hazard icons light up one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 坠落、设备不当、临边、恶劣天气。

shots.scene: 一个三角形，三边空着
shots.prompt_en: A blank triangle with three empty sides. No people.
shots.narration: 消防第一题：火三角是哪三个要素？

shots.scene: 四张选项卡片
shots.prompt_en: Four option cards with icons: water earth and air, heat fuel and oxygen, gas molecules, metal bars. No people.
shots.narration: 水土空气、热燃料氧气、气体、金属。

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案B，热、燃料和氧气。

shots.scene: 灭火器图标，旁边四个字母方块
shots.prompt_en: A fire extinguisher icon next to four blank letter blocks. No people.
shots.narration: 消防第二题：灭火器口诀代表什么？

shots.scene: 欣欣指着题干
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the question.
shots.narration: 这一题只出现了题目，没有展开。

shots.section_title: 起重机能吊的风速看机型
shots.scene: 起重机和风速计
shots.prompt_en: A crane next to an anemometer. No people.
shots.narration: 起重第一题：起重机能安全吊装的最大风速？
overlay: 起重机能吊的风速看机型

shots.section_title: 起重机能吊的风速看机型
shots.scene: 四张选项卡片
shots.prompt_en: Four option cards with wind icons and a crane icon. No people.
shots.narration: 每小时10、20、30英里，还是看机型？

shots.section_title: 起重机能吊的风速看机型
shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案D，取决于起重机的类型和额定能力。

shots.scene: 起重机伸出的支腿
shots.prompt_en: A crane with its outriggers extended. No people.
shots.narration: 起重第二题：支腿有什么用？

shots.scene: 支腿撑稳，起重机不晃
shots.prompt_en: The outriggers press down and the crane stands steady. No people.
shots.narration: 吊装时给起重机提供稳定。

shots.scene: 一个小入口的罐体剖面
shots.prompt_en: A tank cross-section with a small entry hatch. No people.
shots.narration: 有限空间：什么是有限空间？

shots.scene: 人形图标进入，出入口很小
shots.prompt_en: A person icon can enter, but the entry is small. No people.
shots.narration: 够大能进人干活，但进出口受限。

shots.scene: 罐里没有通风箭头
shots.prompt_en: No airflow arrows inside the tank. No people.
shots.narration: 不为长期停留设计，可能通风不良。

shots.scene: 缺氧、骷髅、物理危害三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: low oxygen, a skull and a falling object. No people.
shots.narration: 主要风险：缺氧、有毒物质、物理危害。

shots.scene: 警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A warning triangle icon. No people.
shots.narration: 可能导致事故、受伤，甚至死亡。

shots.scene: 沟槽和挖掘机
shots.prompt_en: A trench next to an excavator. No people.
shots.narration: 开挖第一题：开挖安全的目的是？

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案c，防止事故，保护工人。

shots.scene: 沟壁塌落、地下管线图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a collapsing trench wall and underground utility lines. No people.
shots.narration: 常见危害是土体失稳，还有塌方、碰管线。

shots.scene: 安全帽、反光背心、安全鞋
shots.prompt_en: A hard hat, a high-visibility vest and steel-toed boots. No people.
shots.narration: 防范：戴安全帽，穿反光背心和安全鞋。

shots.scene: 主管沿沟槽检查
shots.prompt_en: A supervisor icon inspects along the trench. No people.
shots.narration: 有能力的管理人员定期检查沟槽。

shots.scene: 土样和放大镜
shots.prompt_en: A soil sample under a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 开挖前，先把土质分析清楚。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在五个主题卡片前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of the five topic cards.
shots.narration: 五个主题，每个二十题，共一百题。

shots.scene: 坠落、火三角图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fall and a fire triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 可能坠落受伤就是高处，火三角热燃料氧。

shots.scene: 起重机、罐体、沟槽图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a crane, a tank and a trench. No people.
shots.narration: 风速看机型，有限空间进出受限，开挖防塌。

shots.scene: 阿杰合上题册，竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The young male student closes the booklet and gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 全做一遍，知识更扎实。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 五大主题竞赛到这里，下次见！
